system.description: This is a general category that covers any one subject desired by the character. On that subject, the character gains +1CS to all Reason FEATs. (Say, the character is into collecting spores and fungus. A Trivia Talent would be: Trivia/Spores and Fungus). Trivia categories should be specific (old movies, military history, sports, rock music, comic books) as opposed to general (all knowledge) or covered by other Talents.
